tools.name: check_dataset_quality
tools.description: Call this before using any dataset. Returns a deterministic quality verdict (RELIABLE / USABLE_WITH_CLEANING / UNRELIABLE) with exact facts: completeness, nulls, type consistency, impossible values, duplicates, outliers, and (on financial/trading data) cross-source price divergence. 100% determinist

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_dataset_quality" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Call this before using any dataset. Returns a deterministic quality verdict (RELIABLE / USABLE_WITH_CLEANING / UNRELIABLE) with exact facts: completeness, nulls…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "clean_scraped_data" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "clean_scraped_data" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp_server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_dataset_quality, clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited · Private data: clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited · Public sink: check_dataset_quality, clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited · Destructive: clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_dataset_quality, clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited · Private data: clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited · Public sink: check_dataset_quality, clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited · Destructive: clean_scraped_data, clean_scraped_data_audited

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
